newsitem.title: USA: Coachman expects to file 10K this week.
newsitem.headline: Coachman expects to file 10K this week.

text.p: Coachman Inc expects to file its 1996 10K with the Securities and Exchange Commission this week reflecting the audit completed June 30, chairman Dennis Bradford told Reuters Wednesday.

The company previously reported on the audit, saying it had earnings of $1.2 million, or $0.04 per share, on revenues of $35.9 million in 1996, which reflected the December 1995 acquisiton of Olympic Mills Corp.
At that time Coachman said it will concentrate all efforts on the expansion of Olympic's textile and apparel manufacturing operations in Guaynbo, Humacao and Yabucoa, Puerto Rico.
The company said it still operates one hotel property in San Antonio, Texas. During 1996, Coachman said, it ceased operation of its retail stores, which had been unprofitable.

Bradford said he expects to report first quarter earnings next week, adding "my goal is to file (the second quarter 10Q) on time." This would result in a report on first half results no later than August 14, he noted.
He declined to discuss first half results during a telephone interview.
